assessments.rationale: evd-001 directly establishes the deployment form and that the host holds customer order records, which is what makes an operator or administrative access path plausible. It does not establish that such a path exists, who holds it, or how far it reaches, and the mapping says so and declares the assumption rather than converting silence into fact. Conditional applicability with an unverified status is the honest reading of one brief passage (explicit architecture documentation at best, and thin at that). Note that evd-001 is the single passage underlying every mapping in this batch: repeated citation across mappings is not corroboration.
missing_evidence: Documentation naming who administers the sync service virtual machine and by what access path (console, SSH, configuration management)
Any operations or runbook document describing privileged access to hosts in the operations subnet
